excerpt: Compare Sharjah areas for Dubai commuters using the actual door-to-door journey, housing and transport costs, and household needs.
introduction:
The best Sharjah area for a Dubai commuter depends on the workplace, departure time and exact building. A home near the border may still involve a long route to a particular office, while a cheaper rent can be offset by fuel, parking or a second car. Test the complete journey before signing.

Al Nahda Sharjah, Al Taawun and Muwaileh are starting points for a search, not a universal ranking. The cost example shows how rent and commuting expenses can be compared across two homes.
takeaways: Measure the full journey from the apartment door to the actual workplace and back.
Compare rent and transport costs together, while accounting for school and other household trips.
Check the current lease, utility and transport terms for the specific home.

sections.heading: Where should a commuter start looking?
sections.body:
[Bayut's Al Nahda Sharjah guide](https://www.bayut.com/area-guides/al-nahda-sharjah/) describes an apartment area on the Dubai–Sharjah border; it should not be confused with Al Nahda in Dubai. Its [Al Taawun guide](https://www.bayut.com/area-guides/al-taawun/) describes a tower district near the border, while [Muwaileh](https://www.bayut.com/area-guides/muwaileh/) offers another residential search area. Test the journey from the building entrance at the times you expect to travel.

Record the actual entrance, parking and road access. If commuting by public transport, include the trip to a stop, waiting, transfers and the final leg to work. Visit on a working day at the time you would travel.

The [Al Majaz and Al Taawun family rental guide](/journal/al-majaz-vs-al-taawun-family-rental-comparison) offers further building and household checks.

sections.heading: Check current transport rather than a map alone
sections.body:
Dubai RTA's [timetable page](https://rta.ae/wps/portal/rta/ae/public-transport/timetable) lists intercity bus services, while [Sharjah RTA's intercity schedule](https://www.srta.gov.ae/en-us/TransportServices/Intercity-Bus-Schedule.html) provides a route and timetable lookup. Verify current stops, hours and fares for the actual journey before relying on a bus.

Include the first and final legs, the wait at a station and the return trip. If driving, record fuel, tolls, parking and maintenance. Test the route more than once; a single quiet day is not a reliable average.

Ask whether work permits flexible hours or remote days. A change in office attendance can materially change the annual cost and time spent travelling.

sections.heading: Compare rent and transport together
sections.body:
Imagine option A costs AED 65,000 in annual rent and AED 16,000 in transport, while option B costs AED 58,000 in rent and AED 26,000 in transport. Their combined amounts are AED 81,000 and AED 84,000. The example applies the same calculation to each of the two rental options.

The chart compares those two totals only. Add utilities, cooling, parking, school transport and non-refundable lease charges where they differ. A lower annual cost is not automatically the best choice if the journey or apartment fails your requirements.

Treat refundable deposits separately as move-in cash, and put all rent instalments on a calendar. Confirm every amount and date in the written agreement.

sections.heading: Inspect the home and its building
sections.body:
Check bedroom layout, storage, cooling, water pressure, windows and visible condition. Confirm the allocated parking and the route from it to the lift. Ask whether cooling and utilities are included, who pays for repairs and how faults are reported.

Visit shared areas and check lifts, entry controls and any facility the household expects to use. If the home is furnished, agree the inventory and condition. Inspect the apartment and compare its layout and view with the property details.

For families, ask schools about places and transport for the exact address. Test the combined school and work route, not only a direct home-to-office trip.

sections.heading: Review the Sharjah lease
sections.body:
Ask for the annual rent, payment dates, deposit, non-refundable fees, maintenance, renewal and early-exit terms. Verify the landlord's or representative's authority and the payment recipient. Record the apartment's condition at handover and retain receipts.

Sharjah Municipality's [residential tenancy contract template](https://portal.shjmun.gov.ae/en/eservices/Attachements/Residential-Tenancy-Contract-Template.pdf) describes attestation and party obligations under the referenced law. Confirm the current process, deadline and charges with the municipality for the actual agreement.

Ask how utility accounts are opened and whether existing balances are settled. A refundable deposit affects the cash needed at move-in even if it is later returned.

sections.heading: Assess the household's full week
sections.body:
List office days, school trips, activities and journeys by other household members. A short commute for one person may require a longer trip for another. Check whether a second car is needed and whether nearby services are accessible to someone without one.

Set a maximum acceptable door-to-door time and a total annual housing and transport budget. Leave room for changes in fuel, rent or working patterns. Compare observations for each actual home rather than assuming the whole area has one experience.

sections.heading: Put the travel time in perspective
sections.body:
For illustration, a journey that is thirty minutes longer in each direction adds one hour on a commuting day. At five days a week for 48 weeks, that is 240 hours in a year. The calculation shows how travel time can be considered alongside the household budget.

Decide how that time affects your family routine and whether flexible hours change the calculation. Avoid treating a chosen value for your time as a cash payment unless it actually changes income or expenses. Record the time separately from rent and transport so both can inform the decision without creating a misleading total.

sections.heading: Request current rental options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Sharjah project collection](/projects?emirate=Sharjah) for local context and ask which relevant rental homes are currently available. Request the current lease terms for the home that fits your preferred commute.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your workplace, preferred bedrooms and budget. Request the exact address and written terms, then test the journey and view the apartment.
